The rusty sword equips the the {{Icon|sword}} slot and when used (Default spacebar) deals damage to enemies in front of you. It cannot be crafted and is given to you by the [[Blacksmith]] when he requests that you kill the slimes to the north. This happens after bringing him [[Horadric]]'s note. The rusty sword begins in disrepair and must be fixed using the [[whetstone]] at the [[Grindstone]]. The rusty sword deals {{Health|-|5}} damage.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|10}}.
